note: Service combos (plan round 3, Step 3): pairs and trios that work together, from shared/flows.json and each pair's AWS page (`source`). When every service in a combo is put up within `radius` tiles in one city, its prop (`sprite`, footprint `size` [w, h] in tiles, art/tiles/combos_art.py) appears with the fact. Plain text for players; the wording is ours.

combos.name: Edge cache arch
combos.simple: CloudFront keeps copies of your S3 files at edge locations, so pages reach visitors fast.

combos.name: Event plaza
combos.simple: API Gateway turns a web request into an event and runs your Lambda function to answer it.

combos.name: Stream fountain
combos.simple: Lambda reads a Kinesis stream in batches, keeping each shard's records in order.

combos.name: Vault garden
combos.simple: AWS Backup copies your RDS databases on a schedule into a vault, ready to restore.

combos.name: Mail chute
combos.simple: Lambda takes SQS messages in batches; a message leaves the queue once it's handled.

combos.name: Signal tower
combos.simple: An EventBridge schedule can start a Step Functions workflow at the times you set.

combos.name: Ticket gate
combos.simple: API Gateway lets a call in only if it brings a valid token from a Cognito sign-in.

combos.name: Quick-pick kiosk
combos.simple: DynamoDB Streams can run a Lambda function each time a table changes.

combos.name: Signpost
combos.simple: A Route 53 alias record points your own domain name at a CloudFront distribution.

combos.name: Lockbox
combos.simple: S3 can lock each file with a key you keep in AWS KMS, and only allowed people can unlock it.

combos.name: Hub bridge
combos.simple: A transit gateway is one hub that connects your VPCs and your own networks.

combos.name: Lakeside reading room
combos.simple: Glue keeps a catalogue of your S3 files, so Athena can query them with SQL where they lie.

combos.name: Robot workshop
combos.simple: AgentCore runs AI agents safely at scale, and they can think with a model on Bedrock.

combos.name: Container yard
combos.simple: With Fargate, ECS runs your containers with no servers for you to look after.

combos.name: Key cabinet
combos.simple: Keep database passwords in Secrets Manager, not in code, and let it change them for you.

combos.name: Watch bell
combos.simple: GuardDuty sends every finding to Security Hub, so you see your threats in one place.

combos.name: Search lantern
combos.simple: DynamoDB can copy each table change into OpenSearch in near real time, so you can search it.

combos.name: Express lane
combos.simple: Global Accelerator gives your EC2 servers fixed IP addresses that bring users in over AWS's network.

combos.name: Live board
combos.simple: AppSync tells every listening app the moment a change is saved, so screens update live.

combos.name: Blueprint stand
combos.simple: CloudFormation can set up the same stacks in each new account that joins your organization.
